verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs say Model APIs support the OpenAI Chat Completions API so you can use familiar client SDKs. They describe the product as OpenAI-compatible, and one doc example points LangChain's ChatOpenAI `base_url` at Baseten. Together these establish the core drop-in pattern. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party example using the official OpenAI SDK with only the base URL and API key changed, documentation of how far compatibility goes beyond Chat Completions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
